@@ -587,6 +587,14 @@ def _annotation_is_complex(annotation: Union[Type[Any], None]) -> bool:
 
 def field_annotation_is_complex(annotation: Union[Type[Any], None]) -> bool:
     origin = get_origin(annotation)
+    
+    # Handle Annotated types by unwrapping to get the actual type
+    if origin is Annotated:
+        # For Annotated types, get the first argument (the actual type)
+        args = get_args(annotation)
+        if args:
+            return field_annotation_is_complex(args[0])
+    
     if origin is Union or origin is UnionType:
         return any(field_annotation_is_complex(arg) for arg in get_args(annotation))
